description: Election Commission - Revision of Electoral Register Notice that the Supplementary Electoral Register 2023 (1) has been Certified under the Registration of Electors Act
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the certification and inspection of the Supplementary Electoral Register 2023(1), which is directly related to voter registration and electoral processes. It is issued by the Commissioner General of Elections and provides details about electoral districts and the officers responsible for the registers. This content fits squarely within the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral registers, election administration, and related electoral matters.
